description: This file contains tests for the server package, focusing on health checks, cache functionality, server ID generation, agent monitoring unregistration, and package synchronization with registry files.

classes.name: fakeCache
classes.description: A mock implementation of a cache for testing cache-related health checks and operations.

classes.name: AgentFieldServer
classes.description: The server struct being tested, containing methods for health checks, agent management, and packaging.

methods.name: TestCheckStorageHealthOverride
methods.description: Tests storage health override returning healthy status.

methods.name: TestCheckStorageHealthWithoutStorage
methods.description: Tests default storage health check when storage is nil.

methods.name: TestCheckStorageHealthContextError
methods.description: Tests storage health check with a canceled context, expecting unhealthy status.

methods.name: TestCheckCacheHealthHealthy
methods.description: Tests cache health check when cache is healthy.

methods.name: TestCheckCacheHealthSetError
methods.description: Tests cache health check when setting cache returns an error, expecting unhealthy status.

methods.name: TestCheckCacheHealthGetError
methods.description: Tests cache health check when getting cache returns an error, expecting unhealthy status.

methods.name: TestHealthCheckHandlerHealthy
methods.description: Verifies health check endpoint returns healthy status.

methods.name: TestHealthCheckHandlerCacheOptional
methods.description: Verifies health endpoint response when cache is optional/not configured.

methods.name: TestHealthCheckHandlerUnhealthyStorage
methods.description: Verifies that endpoint returns 503 when storage health is unhealthy.

methods.name: TestHealthCheckHandlerWithoutStorage
methods.description: Verifies that endpoint returns 503 when storage is not configured.

methods.name: TestGenerateAgentFieldServerIDDeterministic
methods.description: Ensures server IDs generated from the same path are deterministic and unique across paths.

methods.name: TestUnregisterAgentFromMonitoring_NoNodeID
methods.description: Tests agent unregistration API with missing node ID.

methods.name: TestUnregisterAgentFromMonitoring_NoMonitor
methods.description: Tests agent unregistration API when no monitor exists.

methods.name: TestSyncPackagesFromRegistry
methods.description: Tests synchronization of package data from registry files into storage.

methods.name: TestSyncPackagesFromRegistryMissingFile
methods.description: Tests synchronization behavior when registry file is missing.
